title: feat(plugin-security): under a walled posture, deployment-level acceptance of package defaults is host configuration (acceptedDefaultPermissionSets, ADR-0131 D5)
body:
Part of #23385
Clause-②: yes

The code half of #23385. Under a walled posture, a host can declare the deployment-level acceptance of package defaults as configuration: `SecurityPluginOptions.acceptedDefaultPermissionSets`, under ADR-0131 D5. The walled refusal now names that option instead of "create the Default Organization". The card's third item, the ADR-0131 amendment line, is #23883 (Tier H, the maintainer lands it). #23385 remains open until that PR lands, and this PR does not close it.

Authority: objectstack-ai/cloud#2872 ruling A′ (`6160165869`, maintainer 「同意」), item 3, as triage quoted and verified it in `6205580248`.

## What changed

`packages/plugins/plugin-security`:

- **`SecurityPluginOptions.acceptedDefaultPermissionSets?: readonly string[]`** is new. It is read only under a walled posture, using the module's existing `postureEnforcesWall` predicate on the posture the plugin already resolves in `start()`. There is no second reading of the posture. When it is declared, possibly as `[]`, three things follow:
  - `readAcceptedEveryoneSets` derives `everyone` from the declared names. Each name goes through the same per-set checks an accepted row goes through: the catalog serves it under a package, it declares `isDefault: true`, and `describeAnchorForbiddenBits` passes (ADR-0090 D7). A name that fails is withheld with its reason, at `error` for a forbidden bit, as for a row.
  - `syncAudienceBindingSuggestions` reads and writes nothing, so the boot has no throw and the two `(non-fatal)` warn sites stay silent. `reconcileAudienceBindingSuggestions` still counts existing rows once, now as "not read" and naming the option.
  - The list, accept and dismiss doors answer `409 SUGGESTION_STATE` naming the option. The deployment authority still answers first, so a non-operator gets 403.
- **Walled, undeclared:** behaviour is unchanged. With no organization to own the record, the refusal now reads "…Under a walled posture the deployment-level acceptance is host configuration (ADR-0131 D5), never a row a reserved organization owns (ADR-0131 §1.5). Remedy: declare … `acceptedDefaultPermissionSets` …".
- **`single`:** unchanged, including `NO_RECORD_OWNER_MESSAGE`'s text. Every pre-existing call passes no `DeploymentAcceptance`, which reads as the record.
- **Refused loudly.** A malformed value (not a list of non-empty names) is refused at construction (`TypeError`). A declaration under `single` is refused at `start()`, the first moment the posture is known. `single` would never read it, so it would only look enforced.
- Exported widening, all optional or additive: a trailing `deployment?: DeploymentAcceptance` on `readAcceptedEveryoneSets`, `syncAudienceBindingSuggestions` and `reconcileAudienceBindingSuggestions`; `SuggestionDeps.acceptedDefaultPermissionSets?`; the `DeploymentAcceptance` type; and `WithheldAcceptance.source`.
- Changeset: one `minor` for `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

Not touched: no NULL-`organization_id` row, no new table, no `packages/spec` file, not `builtin-positions.ts`.

## Which cases read the declared list: measured, then decided

`resolveDefaultOrganizationId` returns the `default` slug, else the only organization, else nothing. Today, on a walled deployment:

| organizations | today | undeclared (this PR) | declared (this PR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| a `default` slug exists | record owned by it | unchanged | the declaration; record not read |
| exactly one, no `default` | record owned by that tenant | unchanged | the declaration; record not read |
| two or more, no `default` | 409 / boot warn, "create the Default Organization" | 409 / boot warn, names the option | the declaration; no warn |

**Call: a declaration under a wall is the only source, whatever the organization count.** The four-axis reason:

- ① **Need:** cloud's walled control plane falls in row 3 (the audit cloud#2872 `6159344518`: 48 and 12 organizations, no `default`). Reading the list only in row 3 would leave a host's declaration ignored the day a `default`-slug organization appears.
- ② **Long term:** D5 says platform standing under a wall is configuration, and §1.5 rejects an organization owning deployment-level rows. Under a wall, then, a declaration should replace the record, not sit beside it. Two sources would need a merge rule that nothing in the record governs.
- ③ **AI-proof:** "declared ⇒ enforced, always" leaves no posture × organization-count matrix to get wrong. A declaration nothing reads (under `single`) or a malformed one is refused at boot or construction, never skipped.
- ④ **Scope:** no new state. A walled host that declares nothing keeps today's behaviour byte for byte, apart from the message.

## Tests (at `70b3cb0927`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the whole package: **187 files passed, 3725 tests passed, 45 skipped**. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0.
- New pins, one per acceptance line of the card, in the `[ADR-0131 D5] the walled posture …` block of `suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts` (8 tests) and in `walled-accepted-defaults.boot.test.ts` (3 tests, booting a real `ObjectKernel`):
  - walled, no `default`, declared `[]`: the reconcile resolves (no throw, so the plugin's warn sites log nothing), the captured warns are `[]`, `everyone` is the baseline, and accept, dismiss and list answer `SUGGESTION_STATE`/409 with a message whose first sentence is pinned and which names the option;
  - a declared set is granted through `everyone` (absent before), with no row written;
  - a declared high-privilege set is withheld `forbidden: true` and never granted; an unknown, non-`isDefault` or package-less name is withheld with its reason;
  - declared where a `default` organization holds an accepted row: that row is not read;
  - walled, undeclared: 409 with the new message (first sentence pinned, names the option and §1.5, no "create the Default Organization"), identical at the accept door;
  - `single`, both undeclared and with a declaration passed to the module: the message keeps "Remedy: create the Default Organization (slug 'default')";
  - the option's shape refusals, and the `single`-posture boot refusal with its controls (`single` undeclared boots; walled declared boots).
- The `single`-posture suggestion tests already in the file are byte-for-byte unchanged and green. The new block is appended.

**Ablation** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the tests import `src/` relatively, so no `dist/` leg; both restores verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):

1. `hostDeclaredAcceptance` returning `undefined` (the option's read removed): **5 red.** They are declared `[]` (no warn, everyone = baseline, the door refusal); the declared set granted; the forbidden set withheld; unserved names withheld; and the record not read when declared. The other 47 stayed green. That includes the undeclared-walled message, the `single` pins and the shape refusals, which do not depend on the read.
2. `noRecordOwnerMessage` always returning `NO_RECORD_OWNER_MESSAGE`: **1 red**, the walled-undeclared message pin.

## Gates (local, at `70b3cb0927`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 67 families from the 6 changed paths (625 changed lines). All 67 ran, with exit codes captured before any pipe, and all exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 67 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)."

On the first pass, three families exited 3 (prerequisite not met) and one hit my 300 s wrapper. Each was then re-run to a verdict:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed an unshallow clone;
- `check:type-check-debt` ran to exit 0 under the lock in 114 s, and it built every package;
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` exited 0 after that build.

## Acceptance notes

- The posture reading reused: `resolveTenancyPosture()` (`packages/types/src/env.ts:147`) is the deployment's env reading, which plugin-auth's `tenancy` service is built from. The security plugin already reads that service once in `start()` (`this.tenancyPosture`). This PR reads that resolved value through `postureEnforcesWall` (`packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts:53`), the predicate `assertDeploymentAuthority` in this module already uses. It does not call `resolveTenancyPosture()` again, which would be a second reading beside the service.
- When declared, the **list** door also refuses with 409. The card names only the acceptance door. With no record, a list would either be empty and hide the declared `isDefault` sets, or show prompts no door can act on.
- `WithheldAcceptance.source` is a new required field on an exported, output-only type. Only this package constructs the type.
- Observation, not filed: under a wall with exactly one organization, today's record is owned by that tenant. Once a second organization exists, the record's rows count as "not read" (reported by the existing warn) and its acceptances stop granting. A host that declares the option is unaffected.
- The `cloud` adoption (dropping the boot-log warn check ruling A′ added to cloud#2709) is cloud's, at a later pin.
